name: EasySecure Import Export Courses Learndash
author: imminentsoftwares

sections.description:
**LearnDash Course Import & Export – Bulk Upload via CSV is the easiest way to manage LearnDash content in bulk. This plugin lets you import and export LearnDash courses, lessons, and topics using simple and pre-formatted CSV files. Whether you’re migrating from another LMS or just want to manage content faster, this tool saves hours of manual work.

You can bulk upload structured content or export single courses for backup or reuse — all with clean CSV files. A downloadable sample CSV is included to make formatting easy.
sections.installation:
1. Firstly install and activate Learndash plugin.
  2. Upload the easysecure-import-export-courses-learndash folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  4. Navigate to ‘EasySecure Import Export Courses Learndash’ in the WordPress admin menu to start importing or exporting.
sections.faq:
What format should the import file be in?

The import file should be in CSV format. A sample file is available for download from the plugin menu.

Can I export multiple courses at once?

Yes, you can bulk export multiple LearnDash courses from the courses list page in the WordPress admin area.

What happens if an import fails?

If an import fails, check the error message displayed on the import page. Ensure that your CSV file is formatted correctly.
